newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lose ground in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lose ground in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks lost ground in early morning trade on Friday, hurt by falls in the U.S. market overnight, brokers said.
They said many participants were sitting on the fence, reluctant to build fresh positions ahead of the weekend and before a new government is formed.
At 0009 GMT, the Nikkei 225 shares were 237.27 points or 1.13 percent lower at 20,766.22. Its December futures were down 310 points at 20,780.
"Chicago Nikkei 225 futures ended lower than in Osaka yesterday, the Dow fell and on top of that foreign investors are net sellers," a broker said.
